extracted text: The aluminum alloys were solution treated at 530°C for 1h, and immediately quenched into cold water, then aged at 175°C. Alloy A (Ge-free) reached peak hardness (102 HV) after aging for 32h, while Alloy B (Ge-containing) reached peak hardness (140 HV) after aging for 25h. The alloys are in the Al-Cu-Mg system, specifically in the α+θ+S phase field. The paper studies the effect of Ge addition on Al-3.5Cu-0.4Mg (wt.%) alloy.
